verdict.rationale: Zoho Books exposes a full REST API with OAuth2 tokens, documented rate limits, and a published OpenAPI spec, all of which support scripted/CI-driven automation without a UI, and MCP support adds agent-drivable actions. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, official SDK examples for CI pipelines, or headless/batch execution patterns beyond API calls, and OAuth token flow typically requires an initial interactive consent step not shown to be scriptable end-to-end. missing for 10: CLI tool, CI/headless-specific documentation or examples, fully non-interactive OAuth token provisioning, independent verification of automation in CI environments.
